ability.name: Domain Admin Session Mapping
ability.description: Identifies Domain Admin members and current sessions on active hosts using ADSI and native query tools.

stages.stage_name: Enumerate DA Members and Active Sessions
stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $searcher = [adsisearcher]'(cn=Domain Admins)'; $group = $searcher.FindOne(); if ($group) { foreach ($member in $group.Properties.member) { Write-Output "DA Member: $member" } } qwinsta; quser } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\da_sessions.txt

rationale: Queries Domain Admin membership and correlates it with current session data to identify high-value targets.
